verdict.rationale: Lithic provides real auth-time fraud tooling: Authorization Rules v2 can use a 'risk score' attribute (docs-17), ASA lets ops run custom fraud models to approve/decline transactions in real time (docs-2, docs-16), and Events/webhooks (docs-6, docs-20) could surface anomalous activity. Card creation endpoints imply cards can be reissued (docs-9), but the pack has no explicit card block/freeze API, no documented 'suspicious-activity alert' feature, and no mention of network-provided fraud scores (only a generic 'risk score' rule attribute). missing for 10: explicit card block/lock endpoint, dedicated suspicious-activity alerting feature, and confirmation of network (Visa/Mastercard) fraud scores rather than a generic custom risk-score field.
